scope: Ordinary black-border Legends, selected source frames, opt-in set-hsb-v1 printing colors. Three accepted disc targets; other discs retain prior colors.
policy: Frozen scan poses. Sample only the inner 80% radius of the shared fitted disc geometry, then separate paper from ink. Multiple discs of one color count once per card. Fit on original training cards, validate held-out cards. Median Oklab error gain >0.25 and worst held-out regression <=3 required. All accepted targets replayed through actual material preparation and ordinary full-card painting.

shapeDiagnostic.policy: Fixed geometry and references, same edge metric after changing disc colors. Diagnostic only; colors were fitted from paper samples, never selected using this score.

remaining: White, black and generic targets were rejected by the held-out worst-regression gate; retain existing colors until source/scan variation is understood.
Thunder Spirit (white), Ghosts of the Damned (black), and generic-disc outliers need material/scan inspection, not per-card color overrides.
Generic numeral and historic glyph shapes remain separate ink/typography diagnostics.

normalizationReview.note: Original measurements preserved. Corrected frame, color, title/type/symbol rechecks and fresh text validation are reported separately, including retained regressions.
